officers.name: Bhawna Joshi
officers.bio:
Bhawana Joshi works as an IT Manager at Herenga ā Nuku Aotearoa and is passionate about supporting communities, preserving cultural heritage, and creating opportunities for future generations.

As an Executive Member of the Trust, Bhawana contributes her time, energy, and leadership to support the Trust's vision and activities. She values collaboration, inclusiveness, and building strong relationships within the community.

Originally from Nainital, Uttarakhand, India, Bhawana now proudly calls New Zealand home. She has a deep connection to the mountains and enjoys spending time outdoors. The mountains of New Zealand often remind her of her beloved Pahad (hills) back home, helping her stay connected to her roots while embracing life in Aotearoa.

Outside of her professional and community commitments, Bhawana enjoys hiking, swimming, gardening, volunteering, and supporting community events. She is committed to serving the community with integrity, respect, and a genuine desire to make a positive difference.

officers.name: Sangeeta Negi
officers.bio: I am Sangeeta Negi I am from tehri Garhwal, Uttarakhand, I am proud of my roots and deeply connected to the rich culture and traditions of Devbhoomi Uttarakhand. I am passionate about promoting and preserving Uttarakhandi culture. For many years, I have been actively associated with Devbhoomi associations and I work with MBIE.NZ
